zone.description: Only the Tailscale interface. SSH is always on; 22000 is Syncthing's sync protocol, which is not HTTP and cannot be fronted by Tailscale Serve. The Immich, OPDShelf, Syncthing and Navidrome interfaces and the two agent web UIs publish on loopback and reach the tailnet through Serve, so they need no port here; the public edge reads the Immich and OPDShelf Services, so it needs none either. Nothing listens on the LAN.
